# Tracking integration fixture

`two_people_pixabay.mp4` is a two-second local MP4 made from Pixabay image 977170, “Brother, Sister, Girl,” by `terimakasih0` (published 2015-10-09).

Source: https://pixabay.com/photos/brother-sister-girl-family-boy-977170/

The source page identifies it as free for use under the Pixabay Content License. The generated fixture is only for MediaPipe Tasks integration coverage and is not an AutoClip product asset.
